limitations: Incomplete schedule: 6 of 24 executed, only repetition 0; 18 unexecuted, no baseline arm. 2/24 is attained scheduled success, not a full generalization estimate; 2/6 is conditional on this executed prefix.
All measured real inference and browser evidence remain distinct from earlier legacy timings, static/cache audits, one-case development smoke, and future plans.
Further tuning on these revealed six tasks turns them into development data. Future generalization needs a separately frozen untouched set; no training or calibration fit happened here.
Independent Noul p_true scores are not categorical operation probabilities or navigation calibration. Offered-choice scoring emits zero autoregressive tokens and no first-token event.

Original frozen adapter reports no native_latency_ms; input-token/adapter-latency ratios are not pure GPU throughput. Helper completion-token/full-request ratios include prompt/transport, not pure decode speed.
Small heterogeneous/censored descriptive p95 cannot establish stable performance, a speedup over failed baselines, or complete browser/general-web reliability.

Original controller had no full post-run GGUF hash; a separate CPU-only post-window receipt streamed all 9 package files and matches manifest hashes/sizes. This child audit validates that receipt against the manifest and does not stream the full model again.
Three process-group liveness probes were denied. An empty remaining_owned_groups list excludes denied groups and is not proof all groups exited. No denied probe was retried.
